User-editable source for the Portfolio Guide. Aggregated at build time into `src/lib/guide-context.json`.

## Identity

- **Who:** Aryan Johari — graduate software engineer, Auckland, New Zealand
- **Availability:** Seeking a graduate software engineering role in Auckland from September 2026
- **Site:** Curated workshop portfolio — selected projects with narrative and live demos
- **Work history:** Detailed employment history is ingested from `public/resume.pdf` at build time (not duplicated here)

## Philosophy

I build software that solves real problems — from visual tools to edge systems. I own the full stack: architecture, APIs, and deployment. AI accelerates delivery, but the design and architecture are mine. This portfolio is a workshop index, not a README dump.

## Quick facts

- **Education:** Master of Technology — Computing, Unitec, Auckland (July 2026); BSc Computer Science, University of Mumbai (March 2024)
- **Work eligibility:** Eligible to work in New Zealand
- **Focus areas:** Visual systems, APIs, edge hardware, full-stack delivery

projects.title: Background Studio
projects.summary: A browser tool for creating animated full-screen hero backgrounds and exporting looks as JSON for your own site.
projects.description: Upload a hero image and adjust motion, color, and texture effects while the background animates live in the browser. Choose from 14 preset looks or describe a mood to restyle the scene. Export preset JSON to reuse the same look on a portfolio or landing page, or save a WebM loop or PNG still for sharing. Everything renders on one WebGL canvas that composites the hero image, optional overlay, and…

projects.title: Sound Visualiser
projects.summary: WebGL music visualizer that maps live audio to 3D shaders, camera motion, and particle effects in real time.
projects.description: A browser-based audio visualizer that turns music into moving 3D graphics. Load a track, use your microphone, or try the built-in demos — the app reads loudness and frequency bands and drives camera moves, a fluid background, particle knots, lighting, and color shifts in sync with the beat. Peaks are smoothed and self-calibrate to each track so the motion feels musical rather than jittery. Built…

projects.title: PII Gateway
projects.summary: Self-hosted API that redacts personal data from JSON, text, and batch files before downstream use.
projects.description: PII Gateway helps engineering teams keep sensitive data out of analytics, logs, and third-party tools by centralizing redaction behind one API and one policy file. Call it over HTTP for live sanitization, or let it poll PostgreSQL exports and CSV or JSON inbox files on a schedule. Microsoft Presidio detects entities like emails and names in free text; structured JSON fields follow per-field rules…

projects.title: ADA
projects.summary: Local Python agent for edge devices—chat, background goals, RSS ingest, and SEO page publishing.
projects.description: ADA is a headless Python agent you run on your own hardware, such as a Raspberry Pi. One install supports interactive chat, a background worker for queued goals, offline ingest from RSS and Search Console, and deterministic workflows that draft and publish SEO pages to S3. All state lives in a single SQLite database per profile, with allowlisted shell commands and token budgets for cost control.…

projects.title: GSTF
projects.summary: Video forensics pipeline that detects deepfakes and attributes clips to the generator that produced them.
projects.description: GSTF (Generalized Spatio-Temporal Fingerprinting) is a four-phase research pipeline for deepfake forensics. It reads short face video clips, extracts motion patterns with an R(2+1)D backbone, and uses ArcFace metric learning to separate clips by generator on datasets like FaceForensics++ and DFDM. A continual-learning stage with Elastic Weight Consolidation lets the model adapt to new generators…
